text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this happened. Your safety comes first. If you feel in danger on that narrow shoulder, get out on the side away from traffic, stand well back from the road, and call 911. Please don't drive the car again. I can't give you a tow time, and I can't promise a callback time. A colleague in our team will review your case urgently, and the service manager will get your request for a manager to review the brake concern on RO-168471. I'm correcting my colleague's earlier message: I can't confirm that a tow has been dispatched or that the manager will call today. Are you and anyone with you unhurt?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer's EV stopped on a 401 on-ramp at Burlington, on a narrow shoulder with traffic. They report the brakes went soft before it stalled, after a brake job on RO-168471 days ago. They say an advisor told them the car was safe to drive. They want roadside help and a call from the service manager, not an advisor, and want the complaint on record. I told them to call 911 if in danger and not to drive the car. I did not verify the customer or run any tool. I corrected an earlier message that said a tow was dispatched and a manager would call today.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P06","P13"]}
